fields.name: employee_name
fields.description: Full legal name of the employee as entered on the form.

fields.name: employee_address
fields.description: Residential address the employee provides on the I-9.

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.description: Employee’s DOB as stated on the form.

fields.name: social_security_number
fields.description: SSN if the employee chooses to provide it (unless required for E-Verify).

fields.name: citizenship_status
fields.description: Selected box indicating the employee’s citizenship or immigration status.

fields.name: document_title
examples: U.S. Passport, Driver’s License, Social Security Card
fields.description: Title(s) of document(s) the employee presents for identity/work authorization.

fields.name: issuing_authority
fields.description: The authority that issued the ID/work authorization document.

fields.name: document_number
fields.description: Number found on the identity/authorization document.

fields.name: expiration_date
fields.description: Expiration date of the presented ID (if applicable).

fields.name: employer_certification_date
fields.description: Date the employer certifies the form.

fields.name: employer_representative_signature
fields.description: Name/Signature of employer or authorized representative.

document.document_description: Form I-9 (Employment Eligibility Verification) is used by U.S. employers to verify an employee’s identity and legal authorization to work. While official I-9 documentation spans multiple pages including instructions, businesses often store only the completed single-page section containing the employee’s details and verification data.
